title: Add a re-project step to the claim ledger so a changed project-resolution rule rewrites `project` without re-calling the model
notes: derived from the index and cheap to recompute, so if the resolution rule
changes again, rewrite the field rather than re-calling the model -- the
first two rules changed 42 of 527 rows between them.

2026-11-24 audit: verdict not_done, conditional. project is still set once in atrium/curate/run_curate_extract_cli.py:51 via project_of_workspace(conversation_workspaces(...)); the rule has since changed again (ce20e71 refuse scratch dir, 865ea11, 4c6e331). No command in atrium/curate/ re-derives the field on existing ledger rows (grep for reproject/rewrite finds nothing). Smallest next step: a small CLI (e.g. run_curate_reproject_cli) that re-reads ledger rows, recomputes project from conversation workspace, rewrites in place, only when the rule next changes.
